description: 阳台暗光(照度<35Lux或日落后)且S04触发；2026-11-10 草案：要求客厅USB雷达15秒内在2.3米内测到走动（坐沙发约3.3米、静止不算），通过则开灯并置「阳台有人」锁存；雷达JSON不可用或>60秒未上报时退回旧条件(客厅双雷达有人/3分钟内)且不锁存；S13不参与

conditions.alias: 客厅雷达近处走动门控(失效时退回旧条件)
雷达有效且15秒内2.3米内走动
conditions.value_template: {% set j = states.sensor.ld2410_usb_json %}{% set fresh = j is not none and j.state not in ['unavailable','unknown'] and (now() - j.last_reported).total_seconds() <= 60 %}{% set nt = as_datetime(states('sensor.ke_ting_lei_da_jin_chu_zou_dong_shi_jian')) %}{{ fresh and nt is not none and (now() - nt).total_seconds() <= 15 }}
{% set j = states.sensor.ld2410_usb_json %}{% set fresh = j is not none and j.state not in ['unavailable','unknown'] and (now() - j.last_reported).total_seconds() <= 60 %}{{ not fresh }}

variables.radar_ok: {% set j = states.sensor.ld2410_usb_json %}{% set fresh = j is not none and j.state not in ['unavailable','unknown'] and (now() - j.last_reported).total_seconds() <= 60 %}{{ fresh }}
